partition.scope: Exact disjoint complete source-file partition; this is a recommendation and does not execute Playwright.

isolated.reason: All native/document GPU intro ownership, readiness, fallback, reload shutdown and intro viewport tests run serially. The complete input guardrail and passage-render budget files also run serially to isolate ordinary-clock startup/audio/deadline and real-presentation-tick assertions.

partition.limits: Capability/backend/static-artifact skips remain skips with their real suite annotations. File counts are not expanded test-case counts; Playwright collection determines loop-expanded cases. No source assertions/timeouts/retries are relaxed. Production built artifact and execution receipts must be recorded separately.
